description: Forged statements with adaptively rebuilt witnesses (fresh transcript, states, residue root, floor quotients), non-canonical encodings (coordinate +p, n + r, top-bit words, state/quotient aliases), invalid and off-subgroup proof points (including a small-order B that makes the projective trajectory hit Z = 0), transcript re-parses, quotient length/cap, GT-GLS digit attacks (range, negative zero, lattice-shifted digits with stale identities, binding off by one), a signed challenge derivation, and layout mutations. Every run must be rejected.

runs.label: n0 + r (non-canonical alias, honest witness otherwise)
n0 with the top bit set (negative under signed decoding)
n0 + r with a rebuilt transcript
A.x + p (alias) with a rebuilt transcript
B on the twist, not in G2 (rebuilt)
B of order 10069 (exceptional add/doubling; Z = 0 absorbing) (rebuilt)
bytes swapped across the state 1 / state 2 boundary
residue root shifted by one byte (re-parse)
WS from proof 0 with WQ from proof 1
Q with a leading zero word (non-canonical n_q)
Q padded to 133 words (over the cap)
Q length not a multiple of 32
prover used a signed SHA256 -> Fp conversion for rho (fixture 2)
lattice-shifted GLS digits (binding holds) with stale states/quotient
lattice-shifted GLS digits with the states of the alternative witness but the old quotient
extra push between WQ and WS
WQ pushed with a non-minimal PUSHDATA4
